tools.name: ski_search_resorts
tools.description: Find the ski resorts this server covers, by name, id, region tag (e.g. "Colorado", "Alps", "Lake Tahoe") or season pass ("Ikon Pass", "Epic Pass"). Returns resort ids to pass to the other tools. Leave query empty to list everything.

tools.name: ski_list_regions
tools.description: List the region tags resorts are grouped by (states, countries, ranges), with resort counts.

tools.name: ski_get_resort_status
tools.description: Everything known about one resort: live lift status (each lift open, on hold, scheduled, or closed, read from the resort's own site), opening date if the season has not started, a model weather forecast, model snow estimates (depth and snowfall over the last 7/30 and next 7 days at the lower and upp

tools.name: ski_compare_resorts
tools.description: Side-by-side open-lift counts for up to 10 resorts, sorted by share of lifts open. Operator-reported; a resort without a count says whether it listed no lifts or could not be read.

tools.name: ski_find_nearby_resorts
tools.description: Resorts closest to a point, by straight-line distance. Optionally fetches live open-lift counts for each.

tools.name: ski_get_region_summary
tools.description: Open-lift totals for a whole region (a tag from ski_list_regions, e.g. "Utah", "Dolomiti"), with each resort's count. Fetches every resort in the region, so it is limited to 40 resorts.

tools.name: ski_open_now
tools.description: Ski resorts whose own lift board lists running lifts right now, most open lifts first, optionally within a region (a country such as "Chile", a state such as "Colorado", a season pass such as "Ikon Pass" or "Epic Pass", or any tag from ski_list_regions).
